gen-dafont-college-gf-atkinson-hyperlegi: Chunky and confident, College draws each curve as stout as its stems. Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono sits beneath it with spaced-out letters and open counters, and that gap in temperament is what holds the pair together.

Atkinson Hyperlegible Next reads wide-eyed and friendly, its rounds left unlatched so each letter stays easy to tell apart. Over a full page it keeps that open, approachable feel, while College above it stays dynamic and firm.
gen-dafont-college-gf-biryani: Biryani lets every e show a large, clear eye and keeps its strokes uniform, with no thick-and-thin shifts. College does the loud, authoritative work up top; Biryani handles the quieter job below.
gen-dafont-college-gf-blinker: Big, blunt capitals up top, tall lowercase below. Blinker follows with open apertures and letters that fill most of their height, so if College were shrunk down, it would lose the punch that Blinker never needs.
gen-dafont-college-gf-carrois-gothic: Strokes that never swell or thin give College its tube-smooth, authoritative look. Carrois Gothic answers with a high-set x-height and generously opened c, and its size is the one worth adjusting, not the heading's.
gen-dafont-college-gf-carrois-gothic-sc: Carrois Gothic SC opens every curve cleanly and keeps capitals nearly level with the lowercase, a pen-plotter smoothness across the line. College is the dynamic, tall-lowercase voice beside it.
gen-dafont-college-gf-chivo: Chivo reads compact, its lowercase packed up toward the caps while light shows through every curve. College is the showpiece here, smooth as tubing and dynamic, and Chivo is the steady worker underneath it.
gen-dafont-college-gf-chocolate-classica: Chocolate Classical Sans reads large and modern, with a broad-nibbed stroke that never curls shut. Chocolate Classical Sans keeps that generous feel going down a whole column, while College above it draws with a marker-nib line that ignores direction.
gen-dafont-college-gf-comme: College draws in one constant nib width, like a drafting pen tracing outlines. Comme gives a smooth, unclogged read below, its lowercase filling most of the letter height, and that is what makes the pair work.
gen-dafont-college-gf-cossette-texte: Every curve in College is as thick as its stems, with big counters in tall lowercase. Cossette Texte takes over below with wide-eyed e shapes and a prominent x-height, so the two sit together as loud and quiet.
